closingLines.line: 🧭 Katarina returns from the wilds hurt (health 6/100) — the trip cut short.

hurtMealLines.line: Ulrich is away from the haven, hurt (health 6/100), and their pack is empty — nothing to eat out here. They walked away from Haven and haven't come back.

At the grave, Ulrich, Chantal, Sanne speak for Kulpash — "Gilberto trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
Sanne showed Ulrich the Lotus — "remember it." Word gets around.
Ulrich left 3 branches by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.

🔥 The fire settles. Sanne has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Glasswing Darter — I put it down today." "A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you." "It missed. It hits the dirt hard — wings splayed, vulnerable. Kill it now.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Ulrich is calling it "The Ugly Beast." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.
Ulrich is away from the haven, hurt (health 6/100), and their pack is empty — nothing to eat out here. They walked away from Haven and haven't come back.
